notes.title: Small bug fix patch - December 1st 2024
notes.content:
Hi there!, hope you are enjoying revert, just fixing a few things that got missed in our play-testing.
[list]
[*] Hints no longer have large leading tabs that make them unreadable.
[*] Reverting while riding and object, like a box, no longer teleports you to the object's saved location if you revert.
[*] Fixed a few glitches that allowed skipping levels.
[/list]
Nothing huge here but incremental improvement is still improvement! Have fun!

-Higher Up Games
